Karthik / Ben — forwarding Alyssa’s note. She missed the checkpoint due to an operational incident. Recommended next steps from CS/sales POV:

- Proactively offer two reschedule windows (align to her suggested times).
- Prepare an updated engagement plan that pushes the milestone dates by one sprint (2 weeks) and explicitly calls out the new integration owner and success metric owners.
- Leave room in the plan for a short technical handoff call with her integrations lead if Alyssa sends them in.

I can draft the updated plan and send as a one-page PDF for the customer to sign off quickly. Also think it’s reasonable to offer a single-week extension to the pilot timeline given this slip — we can discuss if credit is appropriate, but hold off until we know their internal impact.

If you want, I’ll attach the draft and we can quick-review before sending to Alyssa.
